Digital India

A mobile app mockup made for C.O.R.E.

From the archive

The HTML, stylesheet and images carry 27 October 2015 timestamps.

The Digital India concept packages news and program information into a mobile interface. Its surviving page includes the original screen compositions and names the C.O.R.E. event.

This is a visual record of the app mockup, with the original design preserved in the screenshot.
